desc: Derive and document the reduction: total answer = total pairwise Manhattan distance over all cell pairs * C(m*n - 2, k - 2).
Implement distanceSum using the closed-form total pairwise Manhattan distance multiplied by C(m*n - 2, k - 2) modulo 10^9 + 7.
Validate the solution on the provided examples and edge cases such as k = 2 and k = m*n.
If validation fails, debug the failing case and adjust the formula or combination computation.
